title: Professionals' portal

gate.title: For Living Dose professionals
gate.body: This area is for registered professionals who consult on Living Dose.
gate.live: Once we've verified your registration, our team links your account to your profile. Contact us if you think you should have access.
gate.demo: Demo mode: choose a sample professional to try the portal as them. In the live app, access is set by our team after verification.

demoBanner: Demo mode: you're seeing consultations booked in this browser.

consult.joinNote: The call opens 10 minutes before the start once the video service is connected.
consult.resultsNotShared: The member chose not to share their health check results for this consultation.
consult.summaryHint: The member sees this on their appointment page. Write in plain language.
consult.summaryPlaceholder: What you discussed and the main advice, in a few sentences.
consult.stepPlaceholder: For example: walk 20 minutes after dinner on 3 evenings
consult.sent: Sent. The member can now see your summary.
consult.summaryError: Please write a short summary (at least 20 characters).
consult.privateHint: Only you can see these. They are not shared with the member.
consult.safety: If you're worried about the member's safety, follow the safeguarding procedure and contact the Living Dose clinical lead straight away.

availability.title: Availability
availability.intro: Set the hours you take consultations. Members can only book within these times.
availability.hoursError: Choose a start time before the end time, between 6 AM and 10 PM.
availability.daysOffHint: Holidays, training or leave. Existing bookings on these days aren't cancelled automatically.
availability.saved: Saved. Members now see your new times.
